headline: India's BSNL Q2 Net Loss Widens to Rs 1,532 Crore on 4G Costs
summary: State-owned Indian telecom provider BSNL saw its consolidated net loss widen to 1,532 crore rupees in the September quarter, up from 1,106 crore rupees a year earlier, as revenues slipped and network rollout expenses increased.
why: BSNL is India's state-owned telecommunications operator, undergoing a government-funded nationwide network modernization program.

impacts.name: BSNL
impacts.why: Escalating capital expenditures for 4G expansion alongside weaker revenue widened quarterly net losses.
